stocks.name: Microsoft
stocks.disruption_why: No free product replaces the software companies keep paying for.

gp_assets: Gross profit on assets holds up.
debt: Net debt is well under 2 times EBITDA.
asset_growth: Assets are not growing faster than the business.
cash_conv: Free cash flow covers net income.

report_card.description: Sells software and cloud services that businesses keep paying for.

health.reason: High return on capital and light debt.

trajectory.reason: Sales and profit are still rising.

runway.reason: Cloud still has room, but growth is slower than a few years ago.

risks.reason: A few large customers and a big spending plan.

response.reason: Management has handled past slowdowns without cutting the core business.

issue_log.fix_plan: Watch the next two quarters before changing the grade.

watch_next: Next earnings: is cloud growth still slowing?
Does AI spending stay inside the cash the business already earns?

log.summary: A large customer renewed a multi-year contract.
log.impact: Supports the reason we own the business.

stocks.name: NVIDIA
stocks.disruption_why: Customers are building their own chips. The check is done, and it is not red.

roic: Judged over 7 years because chip demand booms and busts.
gp_assets: Gross profit on assets is strong across the cycle.
asset_growth: Asset growth is matched by sales.

report_card.description: Designs the chips used to train AI models. Demand swings hard, so the score uses a 7-year window.

health.reason: Very high return on capital and no net debt.

trajectory.reason: Still growing, but the pace is no longer a straight line up.

runway.reason: AI spending can pause. The 7-year view already includes past busts.

risks.reason: A few customers are a large share of sales, and they are designing their own chips.

response.reason: The company has cut plans before when demand fell.

issue_log.fix_plan: Keep the disruption flag at yellow and the position at half size until the next filing.

watch_next: Whether the biggest customers keep buying, or switch to their own chips.

log.summary: A new export rule may limit which chips can be shipped.
log.impact: Could change the sales story. Buying waits until the next filing.

log.summary: The share price fell after a broad chip selloff.
log.impact: The price moved. The business story did not.

signals.insider: Light selling, in line with past years

stocks.name: Intel
stocks.disruption_why: Rivals took the lead in manufacturing.
fail_reasons: Return on capital was under 8% in a year.
Profits are not turning into cash.
The spending plan is large next to the cash the business earns.
